project_tracker_diagnostic: Annual; more robust than C. basalis; leaves opposite and usually bipinnately divided into threadlike segments; rays yellow with broad dark reddish-brown basal zones.

project_inclusion.learning_reason: Common and useful Central Texas field-learning taxon.

morphology_keys.habit: Erect branching herb, often somewhat taller/coarser than C. basalis.
morphology_keys.leaves: Opposite below, dissected into many narrow threadlike segments.
morphology_keys.heads: Showy yellow rays with broad maroon to reddish-brown bases; disks dark.
morphology_keys.phyllaries: Outer bracts often spreading beneath a broader inner involucre.

photo_strategy.selection_logic: Prefer curated taxon photos plus multiple views from one Central Texas/Texas observation.
